hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: EulerSwap is a Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM curve backed by Euler lending vaults. It takes full control of swaps via beforeSwapReturnsDelta, depositing input tokens into and withdrawing output tokens from Euler vaults, with configurable fees and an optional timestamp-based expiration that halts swaps after a set deadline.
